matching: Each case is run through both arms with identical input, generation configuration, and seeds where the provider supports deterministic seeds.
provider_determinism: Record provider determinism availability per case; if unavailable, report that the arms are matched inputs but not perfect counterfactual replicas.

continuous_or_count_test.bootstrap_unit: case; use session-cluster bootstrap if a reliable session grouping is available

multiple_testing: Report the preregistered primary outcomes first and label secondary outcomes as secondary; no post-hoc outcome-driven metric selection.
